biological_replicate: the GS consisted of five different samples that contained the same amount of C2C12 lysate but varying concentrations of each spike-in protein

we generated a gold standard spike-in sample set (GS) consisting of C2C12 cell lysate as constant background and 13 non-mouse proteins each in five different concentrations
factor_value: We used five physiologically plausible spike-in amounts of 1.25 to 125 nm per spike-in protein
number_of_fractions: the GS was used for in-solution (IS) digest followed by mass spectrometric acquisition only
number_of_technical_replicates: each sample was measured in triplicate in DDA and DIA mode
number_of_biological_replicates: the GS consisted of five different samples
number_of_samples: the described five spike-in states were measured in triplicates to reflect a common replicate number, resulting in 15 LC-MS/MS runs per method
